title: 10 July 2010: Paul McCartney live at AT&T Park, San Francisco
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the AT&T Park in San Francisco, California, USA, on 10 July 2010.

It was the 13th concert of the Up And Coming Tour, which lasted for 38 dates between March 2010 and June 2011. This show was seen by 40,512 fans.

The setlist was mostly the same as his previous shows in Cardiff and London, although he added ‘San Francisco Bay Blues’, the US folk song by Jesse Fuller previously recorded by McCartney on his 1991 album Unplugged (The Official Bootleg).

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).
